A subsidiary of [[Larsen & Toubro]], the company was incorporated in 1996 and employs more than 87,950 people.{{cite news |last1=Phadnis |first1=Shilpa |last2=Mani |first2=Veena |title=LTIMindtree aspires to be $10bn in revenue: CEO |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/ltimindtree-aspires-to-be-10bn-in-revenue-ceo/articleshow/95544693.cms |access-date=9 December 2022 |work=The Times of India |language=en}} ==History== {{multiple image | direction = vertical | align = right | width = | image1 = Mt Front, Mindtree Chennai (2014).jpg | image2 = L ^ T Powai - panoramio.jpg | image3 = Sattva Global City, Rajarajeshwari Nagar, Bangalore (2024) 75.jpg | footer = LTM campuses | total_width = | alt1 = | caption1 = [[Ramanujan IT City]], Chennai | caption2 = Global Headquarters [[Powai]], Mumbai | caption3 = [[Global Village Tech Park|Sattva Global City]], Bangalore }} The company was founded as L&T Information Technology Ltd in December 1996 as a subsidiary of Larsen & Toubro.{{cite news |title = Sanjay Jalona CEO & MD of LTI|url = http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tech/tech-news/LT-appoints-ex-Infosys-executive-Sanjay-Jalona-CEO-of-IT-unit/articleshow/48452076.cms|work = lntinfotech.com| date=12 August 2015 |access-date = 8 February 2016|publisher = L&T Infotech}} During 2001–2002, the company's name was changed from L&T Information Technology Ltd. to L&T Infotech Ltd., and in the same year, the company achieved the assessed level of the Software Engineering Institute's (SEI) Maturity Level 5.{{cite news| title=expresscomputeronline| url=http://www.expresscomputeronline.com/20020401/indnews17.shtml| date=1 April 2002| access-date=25 November 2012| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040904095904/http://www.expresscomputeronline.com/20020401/indnews17.shtml| archive-date=4 September 2004| url-status=dead}}{{cite web|url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/l-t-infotech-18105/information/company-history|title=Larsen & Toubro Infotech Ltd.|access-date=16 April 2019|via=Business Standard}} Between 2009 and 2012, parent Larsen & Toubro sought to scale up L&T Infotech by making a series of acquisition attempts, for [[Satyam Computer Services]], [[Patni Computer Systems]] and Hexaware Technologies, all three of which proved to be unsuccessful.{{cite news |last1=Sanjai |first1=P R.|last2=Khan |first2=Zahra |title=L&T Infotech plans to enter new markets, make acquisitions |url=https://www.livemint.com/Industry/36CTM7eP21M66qfkhcr9oL/LT-Infotech-plans-to-enter-new-markets-make-acquisitions.html |access-date=26 April 2024 |work=Mint |date=14 October 2013 |language=en}}{{cite news|last1=Barman |first1=Arijit|last2=Shinde |first2=Shivani |title=Now, L&T jumps into Hexaware race to reboot Infotech |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/now-l-t-jumps-into-hexaware-race-to-reboot-infotech-112030700027_1.html |access-date=26 April 2024 |work=Business Standard |date=7 March 2012}} In 2013–14, L&T Infotech's engineering services segment was acquired by parent [[Larsen & Toubro]]'s newly created technology and engineering services subsidiary called [[L&T Technology Services]].{{cite news |title=L&T to set up new arm L&T Technology Services |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/lt-to-set-up-new-arm-lt-technology-services/articleshow/21982025.cms |access-date=14 October 2022 |work=The Economic Times}}{{cite news |last1=Sanjai |first1=P. R. |title=L&T to sell 15% stake in L&T Technology Services via IPO |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/3qE6Qrm4YrKmqdl1LZuJiJ/LT-to-sell-15-stake-in-LT-Technology-Services-via-IPO.html |access-date=14 October 2022 |work=mint |date=15 July 2016 |language=en}} In July 2016, L&T Infotech went [[public company|public]] via an [[initial public offering]] (IPO) of {{INRconvert|1243|c|year=2016|mode=historical}}.{{cite news |last1=Shah |first1=Ami |title=L&T Infotech falls 1.74% on debut; first IPO to list at a discount in 4 months |url=https://www.livemint.com/Money/xoHJj0L7R2sT0cIJvJ2xTO/LT-Infotech-shares-fall-611-first-IPO-to-open-at-a-disco.html |access-date=14 October 2022 |work=mint |date=21 July 2016 |language=en}} Between 2016 and 2017, L&T Infotech had contracts with the [[Income Tax Department]] and [[Central Board of Direct Taxes]] to detect income tax evasion using [[Profiling (information science)|profiling]], [[data model]]s and [[social media analytics]].{{cite news |last1=Seth |first1=Dilasha |title=L&T Infotech bags contract for Project Insight |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/economy-policy/l-t-infotech-bags-contract-for-project-insight-116071700799_1.html |access-date=30 July 2024 |work=Business Standard |date=18 July 2016}}{{cite news |title=L&T Infotech gets $100 million project from CBDT to help pin down tax evaders |url=https://www.livemint.com/Industry/sxRN0AjjwUkUGFBHboQsGI/LT-Infotech-gets-100-million-project-from-CBDT-to-help-pin.html |access-date=30 July 2024 |work=Mint |date=1 October 2017}} The company rebranded itself as 'LTI' with a tag line of 'Let's Solve' in May 2017.{{cite web|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/lt-infotech-rebrands-itself-as-lti-in-keeping-with-new-business-reality-2270673.html|title=L&T Infotech rebrands itself as LTI in keeping with new business reality|website=Moneycontrol|date=4 May 2017 |access-date=16 April 2019}} ===Mindtree merger=== In June 2019, Larsen & Toubro completed its [[Takeover#Hostile takeover|hostile takeover]] of Bengaluru-based company [[Mindtree]], despite opposition from the latter's promoters.{{Cite web |last=Laskar |first=Anirudh |date=2019-06-26 |title=With 60% stake, L&T completes its hostile takeover of Mindtree |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/with-60-stake-l-t-completes-its-hostile-takeover-of-mindtree-1561536743325.html |access-date=2023-08-17 |website=mint |language=en}} In May 2022, it was announced that Mindtree, which was then a different IT services subsidiary of Larsen & Toubro, will be merged into LTI,{{Cite news |last=Press Trust of India |first= |date=2022-06-19 |title=L&T Infotech-Mindtree merger likely by December, says LTI COO |work=Business Standard India |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/l-t-infotech-mindtree-merger-likely-by-december-official-122061900849_1.html |access-date=2022-07-07}} and the company will be renamed as LTIMindtree.{{cite news|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/ltimindtrees-banking-fin-portfolio-to-be-5th-largest/articleshow/91425364.cms|title=LTIMindtree to have fifth largest BFSI portfolio|newspaper=The Times of India |date=9 May 2022 }} Larsen & Toubro Group chairman [[A. M. Naik]] commented that there was not much overlap between the two companies in terms of industries and clientele; LTI had a plurality in [[BFSI]] industry and was active in the oil and gas sector, while Mindtree had a plurality in [[Media (communication)|technology, media and telecommunications]] (TMT) with a presence in travel and hospitality.{{cite web|url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/ltimindtree-begins-life-in-the-big-league-11668454288057.html|title=LTIMindtree begins life in the big league|date=15 November 2022 }} The merger was completed in November 2022. Subsequent to Merger, company changed name to LTIMindtree, becoming India's fifth largest provider of IT services by market capitalization and sixth largest by revenue. Shares of Mindtree were delisted and shareholders were allotted 73 shares of LTI for every 100 shares of Mindtree held. The parent company, Larsen & Toubro, held a 68.73% stake in the merged entity.{{cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/lti-mindtree-merger-takes-effect-latter-to-delist-from-bourses-on-nov-24/article66135921.ece|title=Merged entity. LTI-Mindtree merger takes effect; latter to delist from bourses on Nov 24|date=14 November 2022 }} In February 2026, LTIMindtree Limited announced that it would change its name to LTM Limited.{{cite news |last1=Shinde |first1=Shivani |title=LTIMindtree unveils new identity, to be renamed LTM Limited; board approves extract: LTM Limited (formerly LTIMindtree Limited) is an Indian multinational information technology services and consulting company based in Mumbai. A subsidiary of Larsen & Toubro, the company was incorporated in 1996 and employs more than 87,950 people.
